text:
kevin: @sara FYI inbound from sales — customer 'ScaleData' needs Dedicated pool for a mixed realtime+batch inference workload. They want sustained ~2.5k concurrent streams (avg ~1k tokens/stream), p95 end-to-end gen latency <300ms, and the ability to burst to ~6k concurrent for up to 10 minutes/day. Asking for rough sizing + pricing delta reserved vs burst.

sara: thanks. key clarifying q's: which model family (gpt-medium-like or larger), expected sequence length distribution, and can they accept a slightly higher p95 if cost is much lower? also any regulatory constraints?

kevin: prod uses a 34B open model (fp16) for quality, but they'd accept a quantized 8-bit variant if perf is same. Seq length: 80% <1024, 20% up to 4096. No specific compliance flags, but they want data isolation (Dedicated).

mike: rough ballpark: for that mix on A10G-class GPUs you get ~40 concurrent low-latency streams per GPU at ~300ms p95 for 34B fp16 if we do aggressive batching + KV cache. For H100 perf is ~2.5x. So sustained 2.5k streams -> ~63 A10G GPUs (with 20% safety) or ~25 H100. Burst to 6k would need infra for ~150 A10G or ~60 H100 if we want headroom and instant routes.

raj: @mike do you account for batching variability and cold-cache penalty? Also we should consider prefix caching to reduce steady tokens. We usually recommend a 30% overcommit margin for autoscale ramp.

mike: yes accounted for baseline cache-warm. Cold traffic could double token compute for first few requests; plan warm-start or provision small warm pool. autoscale must be aggressive on scale-up but conservative on scale-down to avoid flapping.

eva: from SE: customer will likely accept temporary model fallback to a quantized 13B for burst windows if we can keep latency SLO. That reduces GPU requirements ~3x. Also we can propose multilayer routing: reserved steady pool + burst on-demand that uses cheaper preemptible nodes.

raj: initial actionable estimate for product backlog item: 1) sizing calc (A10G/H100) for sustained + burst, 2) autoscale policy templates (scale up/down thresholds, cooldown), 3) pricing delta doc (reserved commit vs on-demand burst + fallback model option), 4) launch guards (monitoring, canary, fallback routes).

sara: agree. add eval criteria: perf regression <5% vs baseline, cost per 1M tokens within 20% of estimate, and automated fallback success rate >99% during bursts. Also require runbook for oncall.

mike: draft autoscale policy snippet to discuss:
```
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 8   # reserved steady pool
  max_replicas: 160 # supports full burst on A10G
  metric: concurrent_streams_per_gpu
  target_per_gpu: 35
  scale_up_threshold: 0.8
  scale_down_threshold: 0.3
  cooldown_seconds: 60
  fallback_strategy: route_to_quant13b_if_latency_p95>350ms
```

kevin: sales asks for a one-pager with sizing numbers + 3 pricing options (reserved commit, hybrid reserved+burst, pay-as-you-go with quantized fallback). Can we have that by EOD tomorrow?

raj: I'll run a quick perf sim and give a numbers table by EOD. need sample traces; @kevin can you push customer request (QPS/seq hist) into the shared drive?

kevin: uploading sample traces now -> link: https://redwood.example/s/ScaleData/traces. Also added their target SLA doc.

deploy-bot: CI build for perf-sim pipeline completed: artifacts at https://ci.redwood/perf-sim/1772501234.

mike: grabbing traces. I'll produce A10G vs H100 cost/sizing table + notes on warm pools and preemptible burst options.

sara: next steps/owners: raj -> perf sim + numbers; mike -> infra sizing + autoscale policy; eva -> fallback + solution doc; kevin -> customer context + cost constraints. We'll review in 24h. :thumbsup:

kevin: noted, thanks everyone.

raj: ack, starting sims now.

mike: ack. I'll also prototype a traffic-shaping canary to validate fallback route before customer traffic hits it.

sara: adding this to product backlog as P1-customer-intake/dedicated-scaling. Link to card: https://board.redwood/product/boards/324/cards/5678

kevin: customer happy to join a quick sync once we have the one-pager.

sara: will set up a 30m sync after we have the draft.
